entities.summary: The Batllava Lake is a lake in northeastern Kosovo. It is one of the largest bodies of water in Kosovo and it has an area of 3.29 km2 (1.27 sq mi). The bathing lake is a main tourist destination in summer. Batllava Lake is a lake in Southern Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
